cues.zh: （笑声）

cues.en: And once you get over the backhanded nature of that,

cues.en: there was actually something very profound there.

cues.zh: 他们是在说，比起自己的表亲本人，
cues.en: They were saying that they preferred the automated version of their cousin

cues.en: You have this situation where now they can pause and repeat their cousin,

cues.en: without feeling like they're wasting my time.

cues.en: the very last thing you need

cues.en: is another human being saying, "Do you understand this?"

cues.en: Then I started getting letters from teachers,

cues.en: I now have the students doing in the classroom."

cues.zh: （掌声）

cues.en: I want to pause here, because there's a couple of interesting things.

cues.zh: 第一，当那些老师这样做的时候，
cues.en: One, when those teachers are doing that,

cues.zh: 有一个显而易见的好处——
cues.en: there's the obvious benefit --

cues.zh: 好处就是现在他们的学生
cues.en: the benefit that now their students

cues.zh: 可以像我表亲那样享受这些视频，
cues.en: can enjoy the videos in the way that my cousins did,

cues.zh: 他们可以暂停、按自己的节奏和時間重复观看。
cues.en: they can pause, repeat at their own pace, at their own time.

cues.zh: 但更有趣的是——这是反直觉的一点
cues.en: But the more interesting thing -- and this is the unintuitive thing

cues.zh: 当你谈论课堂上的技术时——
cues.en: when you talk about technology in the classroom --

cues.zh: 通过把一刀切的讲座从课堂上移除，
cues.en: by removing the one-size-fits-all lecture from the classroom,

cues.zh: 让学生在家按自己的节奏学习，
cues.en: and letting students have a self-paced lecture at home,

cues.zh: 那么当你回到课堂上时，
cues.en: then when you go to the classroom,

cues.zh: 让他们做练习，老师四处走动，
cues.en: letting them do work, having the teacher walk around,

cues.zh: 让同伴之间能够真正互动，
cues.en: having the peers actually be able to interact with each other,

cues.zh: 这些老师用技术让课堂更人性化了。
cues.en: these teachers have used technology to humanize the classroom.

cues.zh: 他们经历了一种从根本上剥夺人性的体验——
cues.en: They took a fundamentally dehumanizing experience --

cues.zh: 30个孩子手指放在嘴唇上，
cues.en: 30 kids with their fingers on their lips,

cues.zh: 不许互相交流。
cues.en: not allowed to interact with each other.

cues.zh: 一个老师，无论多优秀，
cues.en: A teacher, no matter how good,

cues.zh: 都得给30个学生上这种一刀切的课——
cues.en: has to give this one-size-fits-all lecture to 30 students --

cues.zh: 面无表情，略带敌意——
cues.en: blank faces, slightly antagonistic --

cues.zh: 而现在这成了一种人性化的体验，
cues.en: and now it's a human experience,

cues.zh: 现在他们真正在互相交流。
cues.en: now they're actually interacting with each other.

cues.zh: 所以，当可汗学院——
cues.en: So once the Khan Academy --

cues.en: I quit my job,

cues.zh: 我们把它变成了一个真正的组织——
cues.en: and we turned into a real organization --

cues.zh: 我们是一个非营利组织——
cues.en: we're a not-for-profit --

cues.zh: 问题是，我们如何把它提升到下一个层次？
cues.en: the question is, how do we take this to the next level?

cues.zh: 我们如何把那些老师在做的事情推向其自然的结论？
cues.en: How do we take what those teachers were doing to its natural conclusion?

cues.zh: 那么，我在这里展示的，
cues.en: And so, what I'm showing over here,

cues.zh: 这些是实际的练习
cues.en: these are actual exercises

cues.en: that I started writing for my cousins.

cues.en: The ones I started were much more primitive.

cues.en: This is a more competent version of it.

cues.zh: 但这里的模式是，你需要多少题，我们就生成多少题，
cues.en: But the paradigm here is, we'll generate as many questions as you need,

cues.zh: 直到你掌握那个概念，直到你连续答对10道。
cues.en: until you get that concept, until you get 10 in a row.

cues.zh: 可汗学院的视频就在那里。
cues.en: And the Khan Academy videos are there.

cues.zh: 你能获得提示，以及那道题的具体步骤，
cues.en: You get hints, the actual steps for that problem,

cues.zh: 如果你不知道怎么做的话。
cues.en: if you don't know how to do it.

cues.zh: 这里的模式看起来很简单：
cues.en: The paradigm here seems like a very simple thing:

cues.zh: 连续答对10道，你就继续往下学。
cues.en: 10 in a row, you move on.

cues.zh: 但这与现在课堂上
cues.en: But it's fundamentally different

cues.zh: 的做法有着根本的不同。
cues.en: than what's happening in classrooms right now.

cues.zh: 在传统课堂上，
cues.en: In a traditional classroom,

cues.zh: 你有作业、讲课、作业、讲课，
cues.en: you have homework, lecture, homework, lecture,

cues.zh: 然后有一次快照式考试。
cues.en: and then you have a snapshot exam.

cues.zh: 而那场考试，不管你得了70分、80分、
cues.en: And that exam, whether you get a 70 percent, an 80 percent,

cues.zh: 90分还是95分，
cues.en: a 90 percent or a 95 percent,

cues.zh: 全班都会继续进入下一个主题。
cues.en: the class moves on to the next topic.

cues.zh: 即便是那个考了95分的学生——
cues.en: And even that 95 percent student --

cues.zh: 他们不会的那5%到底是什么？
cues.en: what was the five percent they didn't know?

cues.zh: 也许他们不知道把一个数提升到零次方会发生什么。
cues.en: Maybe they didn't know what happens when you raise something to the zeroth power.

cues.zh: 然后你在下一个概念上继续构建。
cues.en: Then you build on that in the next concept.

cues.zh: 这就类似于——想象一下学骑自行车。
cues.en: That's analogous to -- imagine learning to ride a bicycle.

cues.zh: 也许我提前给你讲一堂课，
cues.en: Maybe I give you a lecture ahead of time,

cues.zh: 然后给你一辆自行车练两周，两周后我回来，
cues.en: and I give you a bicycle for two weeks, then I come back after two weeks,

cues.zh: 说：“好吧，咱们看看。你转弯有点困难。
cues.en: and say, "Well, let's see. You're having trouble taking left turns.

cues.zh: 你还不太能停下来。你算是个80%的骑车人。”
cues.en: You can't quite stop. You're an 80 percent bicyclist."

cues.zh: 于是我在你额头上盖个大大的“C”章——
cues.en: So I put a big "C" stamp on your forehead --

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 然后我说：“给你一辆独轮车。”
cues.en: and then I say, "Here's a unicycle."

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 但尽管听起来很荒谬，
cues.en: But as ridiculous as that sounds,

cues.zh: 这正是我们课堂上现在发生的事。

cues.en: "What would you do if you had carte Blanche in a classroom?"

cues.zh: 我说：“那每个学生都会按自己的节奏学习，
cues.en: I said, "Well, every student would work at their own pace,

cues.zh: 学类似这样的内容，我们会提供一个仪表盘。”
cues.en: on something like this, we'd give a dashboard."

cues.zh: 他们说：“这有点激进，我们得考虑一下。”
cues.en: They said, "This is kind of radical. We have to think about it."

cues.zh: 我和团队其他人都觉得：“他们肯定不会想这么干。”
cues.en: Me and the rest of the team were like, "They're never going to want to do this."

cues.zh: 但 literally 第二天他们就说：“你能两周内开始吗？”
cues.en: But literally the next day they were like, "Can you start in two weeks?"

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: BG：所以现在五年级数学正在这么做？
cues.en: BG: So fifth-grade math is where that's going on right now?

cues.zh: SK：是两个五年级班和两个七年级班。
cues.en: SK: It's two fifth-grade classes and two seventh-grade classes.

cues.zh: 他们是在学区层面推进这件事。
cues.en: They're doing it at the district level.

cues.zh: 我觉得他们兴奋的是能跟踪这些孩子，
cues.en: I think what they're excited about is they can follow these kids,

cues.zh: 不只是在学校的表现；圣诞节的时候，我们看到有些孩子还在做。
cues.en: not only in school; on Christmas, we saw some of the kids were doing it.

cues.zh: 我们可以追踪一切，追踪他们穿过整个学区的过程。
cues.en: We can track everything, track them as they go through the entire district.

cues.zh: 经过一个个夏天，他们从一个老师换到下一个老师，
cues.en: Through the summers, as they go from one teacher to the next,

cues.zh: 你拥有这种数据的连续性，即使在学区层面也能看到。
cues.en: you have this continuity of data that even at the district level, they can see.

cues.zh: BG：我们看到的一些视图是给老师用的，
cues.en: BG: So some of those views we saw were for the teacher

cues.zh: 让老师进去追踪那些孩子实际的情况。
cues.en: to go in and track actually what's going on with those kids.

cues.zh: 所以你会从那些老师的视图里得到反馈，
cues.en: So you're getting feedback on those teacher views

cues.zh: 来了解他们认为自己需要什么？
cues.en: to see what they think they need?

cues.zh: SK：哦是的。其中大部分是老师们提出的规格。
cues.en: SK: Oh yeah. Most of those were specs by the teachers.

cues.zh: 我们做了一些给学生看的，让他们能看到自己的数据，
cues.en: We made some of those for students so they could see their data,

cues.zh: 但我们和老师本身有一个非常紧密的设计循环。
cues.en: but we have a very tight design loop with the teachers themselves.

cues.zh: 他们会说，“嘿，这不错，但是——”
cues.en: And they're saying, "Hey, this is nice, but --"

cues.zh: 比如那个焦点图表，很多老师说，
cues.en: Like that focus graph, a lot of the teachers said,

cues.zh: “我感觉很多孩子都在跳来跳去，
cues.en: "I have a feeling a lot of the kids are jumping around

cues.zh: 没有专注于一个主题。”
cues.en: and not focusing on one topic."

cues.zh: 于是我们做了那个焦点图。
cues.en: So we made that focus diagram.

cues.zh: 所以一直都是老师在推动。挺疯狂的。
cues.en: So it's all been teacher-driven. It's been pretty crazy.

cues.zh: BG：这准备好正式上线了吗？
cues.en: BG: Is this ready for prime time?

cues.zh: 你觉得下学年很多班级都应该试试这个吗？
cues.en: Do you think a lot of classes next school year should try this thing out?

cues.zh: SK：是的，准备好了。
cues.en: SK: Yeah, it's ready.

cues.zh: 我们网站上已经有上百万人了，
cues.en: We've got a million people on the site already,

cues.zh: 所以再多一些也没问题。
cues.en: so we can handle a few more.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 不，没有理由说它真的不可能发生
cues.en: No, no reason why it really can't happen

cues.zh: 明天在美国的每一间教室里。
cues.en: in every classroom in America tomorrow.

cues.zh: BG：还有那个辅导功能的设想。
cues.en: BG: And the vision of the tutoring thing.

cues.zh: 那里的想法是，如果我对某个主题感到困惑，
cues.en: The idea there is, if I'm confused about a topic,

cues.zh: 在用户界面里就能直接找到，
cues.en: somehow right in the user interface,

cues.zh: 我会找到那些正在做志愿辅导的人，
cues.en: I'd find people who are volunteering,

cues.zh: 也许还能看到他们的信誉评价，
cues.en: maybe see their reputation,

cues.zh: 然后我就能预约并联系上这些人？
cues.en: and I could schedule and connect up with those people?

cues.zh: SK：当然。这也是我建议在座每位都去做的事。
cues.en: SK: Absolutely. And this is something I recommend everyone in this audience do.

cues.zh: 老师们用的那些仪表盘，你现在就可以登录进去
cues.en: Those dashboards the teachers have, you can go log in right now

cues.zh: 你基本上就能当个教练
cues.en: and you can essentially become a coach

cues.zh: 给你的孩子、侄子、表亲
cues.en: for your kids, your nephews, your cousins,

cues.zh: 或者给男孩女孩俱乐部的孩子们当教练
cues.en: or maybe some kids at the Boys and Girls Club.

cues.zh: 没错，你可以开始当导师、当家教
cues.en: And yeah, you can start becoming a mentor, a tutor,

cues.zh: 而且是马上就能开始
cues.en: really immediately.

cues.zh: 总之，一切都在那儿了
cues.en: But yeah, it's all there.

cues.zh: BG：嗯，太棒了
cues.en: BG: Well, it's amazing.

cues.zh: 我觉得你们刚才看到的，就是教育的未来
cues.en: I think you just got a glimpse of the future of education.

cues.zh: BG：谢谢。SK：谢谢。
cues.en: BG: Thank you. SK: Thank you.

cues.zh: （掌声）
cues.en: (Applause)
